title: GPT-5.6 Sol versus GPT-5.5 for project orientation
hypothesis: GPT-5.6 Sol produces an equally grounded but more useful and token-efficient project orientation than GPT-5.5 under the same LCA agent loop.
falsified_if: GPT-5.6 Sol has a lower deterministic pass rate or mean score, or does not improve at least one of answer quality, output tokens, or elapsed time without materially worsening the others.
efficiency_outcomes: prompt, cached, cache-write, and output tokens
decision_rule: Adopt GPT-5.6 Sol for orientation only if five runs are non-inferior on deterministic pass rate and score and show a useful quality or efficiency gain. Do not generalize to coding tasks until auth, existing-codebase edit, recovery, and investigation scenarios also pass a model comparison.
